final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.product_id AS pid, pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(oi.product_quantity) AS aq, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS c FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.pid, s1.d, s1.aq, s1.c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.t AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT d, AVG(aq) AS a2, AVG(c) AS a3, AVG(ratio) AS a4 FROM s3 GROUP BY d) SELECT AVG(a2), AVG(a3), AVG(a4) FROM s4
